dev.title: Developer API
dev.description: Static endpoints to integrate Yoto catalogue icons into your applications. No API key, no backend.
dev.quickstartContent: Data is served as static files from the base URL below. No API key is required: a plain fetch is enough.
dev.endpointsIntro: The catalogue exposes three public files, served by GitHub Pages:
dev.endpointSummaryDesc: Catalogue summary: total count, plus counters by source, category and author.
dev.endpointManifestDesc: Manifest: published sources, counters and catalogue version.
dev.endpointShardsDesc: Per-source shards (one file per source, concatenable).
dev.shardsNote: The index.json manifest and the per-source shards (icons-by-source/{source}.json) are published to GitHub Pages: the frontend loads them progressively. Per-category shards (icons-by-category/…), icons.json and per-icon metadata (icons/{id}.json) are only generated in the local dist/ and are not published.
dev.corsNote: Files are served by GitHub Pages; provide a server-side fallback if your client requires CORS.
dev.schemaIconDesc: Icon fields: id (content identifier = base64url(sha256)), source, tags, artist, title, preview_image, download_url, category, subcategory, downloads, date_added, license and metadata (including source_id, the source's native identifier).
dev.schemaSummaryDesc: The summary contains schemaVersion, catalogVersion, updatedAt, total, counts (bySource, byCategory, byArtist, bySubcategory, topTags, topArtists) and duplicates (cross-source semantic duplicates + content: merged content duplicates).
dev.codeExamplesContent: Load summary.json first (small) for counters, then the index.json manifest and the per-source shards to rebuild the search index client-side.
dev.performanceContent: Shards total ~18 MB: render as soon as the first shard arrives, then complete in the background; cache the catalogue client-side.
dev.versioningContent: The summary schemaVersion field indicates the schema version; catalogVersion (format YYYY.MM.DD-N) identifies the build.
dev.stabilityContent: Existing fields are never removed, only new fields are added.
dev.licenceContent: This catalogue's code is licensed under MIT. Icons remain the property of their authors: check each icon's license field (e.g. CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC, Yoto Official).
dev.attributionContent: Credit the author (@handle) and source of every icon you reuse.
dev.contentsContent: Icon metadata only: no personal data. Images and download URLs belong to their respective creators.
dev.resourceApiSourceDesc: scrapers and build-api.js in the repository
